metadata.description: Hand-encoded major inland-waterway systems that move bulk freight. Coverage is intentionally curated rather than exhaustive — secondary basins are excluded. Class assignments translate native country classifications onto the CEMT scale for cost/CO2 lookup. Tonnage is the practical maximum loaded barge or convoy on the segment, not the structural lock maximum.
primary_sources: PIANC Working Group 156 (inland navigation classifications and emissions)
USACE Inland Waterway Navigation: Value to the Nation 2022
CCNR Annual Report on Inland Navigation in Europe
Yangtze River Administration of Navigational Affairs
Inland Waterways Authority of India NW1/NW2

properties.name: Mississippi River (St Louis to Mouth)
properties.notes: Lock-and-dam free below St Louis; 15-barge tows. Geometry traces major bends through Cape Girardeau / Memphis / Helena / Greenville / Vicksburg / Natchez / Baton Rouge / NOLA.

properties.name: Mississippi River (Minneapolis to St Louis)
properties.notes: 27-lock UMR system; 9-barge tow max.

properties.name: Ohio River
properties.notes: Pittsburgh to Cairo confluence with Mississippi; coal-dominant. Traces real bends through Wheeling / Marietta / Huntington / Cincinnati / Louisville / Evansville / Paducah.

properties.name: Illinois Waterway
properties.notes: Chicago to Mississippi confluence at Grafton; eight locks.

properties.name: Tennessee River
properties.notes: Knoxville to Paducah confluence with Ohio; TVA locks.

properties.name: Cumberland River
properties.notes: Nashville to Smithland confluence with Ohio.

properties.name: Gulf Intracoastal Waterway (West)
properties.notes: Brownsville to NOLA; bulk and chemical.

properties.name: St Lawrence Seaway
properties.notes: Lake Ontario to Gulf of St Lawrence; iron ore, grain.

properties.name: Great Lakes (Duluth to Buffalo)
properties.notes: Duluth-Sault-Detroit-Cleveland-Buffalo; iron ore, coal, limestone, grain.

properties.name: Welland Canal
properties.notes: Lake Erie to Lake Ontario bypass of Niagara.

properties.name: Rhine (Rotterdam to Basel)
properties.notes: Europe's largest inland freight artery; iron ore, coal, ag, container. Trace passes Nijmegen, Wesel, Duisburg, Düsseldorf, Köln, Bonn, Koblenz, Bingen, Mainz, Worms, Mannheim, Karlsruhe, Strasbourg.

properties.name: Main River
properties.notes: Mainz to Bamberg; canalised.

properties.name: Main-Danube Canal
properties.notes: Bamberg to Kelheim; transcontinental Rhine-Danube link.

properties.name: Danube (Kelheim to Budapest)
properties.notes: German-Austrian-Slovak-Hungarian section.

properties.name: Danube (Budapest to Sulina)
properties.notes: Iron Gates lock allows large convoys; Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia.

properties.name: Rhône
properties.notes: Lyon to Mediterranean; bulk and container.

properties.name: Saône
properties.notes: Chalon to Lyon Rhône confluence.

properties.name: Elbe
properties.notes: Hamburg to Czech border; navigability seasonal.

properties.name: Mittellandkanal
properties.notes: Rhine-Elbe-Oder canal link across Germany.

properties.name: Oder
properties.notes: Wrocław to Szczecin; modernisation under EU programme.

properties.name: Seine (Le Havre to Paris)
properties.notes: Le Havre estuary to Paris; bulk aggregates and grain.

properties.name: Yangtze (Wuhan to Shanghai)
properties.notes: Largest cargo-tonnage river worldwide; ore, coal, container, ag. Trace passes Huangshi, Jiujiang, Anqing, Tongling, Wuhu, Nanjing, Zhenjiang, Nantong.

properties.name: Yangtze (Chongqing to Wuhan)
properties.notes: Three Gorges Dam ship-lift constrains; mid-stream. Trace passes Fuling, Wanzhou, Yichang (Three Gorges), Yueyang.

properties.name: Pearl River (Xi Jiang)
properties.notes: Wuzhou-Guangzhou-Hong Kong; bulk and container feeder.

properties.name: Grand Canal (Hangzhou to Huai'an)
properties.notes: Active southern bulk-freight section; coal/aggregates.

properties.name: Volga (Moscow Canal to Astrakhan)
properties.notes: Volga-Don-max vessel ~5000 t; oil, grain, fertiliser. Trace passes Tver, Rybinsk, Yaroslavl, Kostroma, Nizhny Novgorod, Cheboksary, Kazan, Ulyanovsk, Samara, Saratov, Volgograd.

properties.name: Volga-Don Canal
properties.notes: Volgograd to Kalach; thirteen locks; Caspian-Azov-Black-Sea link.

properties.name: Don
properties.notes: Volga-Don canal exit to Sea of Azov.

properties.name: Kama
properties.notes: Perm to Volga confluence; potash, fertiliser, oil.

properties.name: Ob
properties.notes: Novosibirsk to Gulf of Ob; seasonal (May-October).

properties.name: Irtysh
properties.notes: Omsk to Ob confluence; seasonal.

properties.name: Yenisei
properties.notes: Krasnoyarsk to Dudinka; Norilsk Nickel mineral barging.

properties.name: Amur
properties.notes: Khabarovsk to Tatar Strait; timber, coal, aggregates.

properties.name: Paraná (Asunción to Río de la Plata)
properties.notes: Soya, iron ore, fertiliser; Argentina + Paraguay. Trace passes Posadas, Corrientes, Resistencia, Goya, Santa Fe, Rosario.

properties.name: Paraguay (Cáceres to Asunción)
properties.notes: Bolivia/Brazil iron ore export route. Trace passes Puerto Quijarro, Puerto Suárez, Corumbá, Concepción.

properties.name: Amazon (Manaus to Belém)
properties.notes: Soya export corridor; iron ore (Cargill Santarém). Trace passes Itacoatiara, Parintins, Óbidos, Santarém, Almeirim, Gurupá, Belém.

properties.name: Madeira
properties.notes: Porto Velho to Itacoatiara confluence with Amazon; soya.

properties.name: Tapajós
properties.notes: Itaituba to Santarém transhipment; soya.

properties.name: Orinoco
properties.notes: Iron ore Ciudad Guayana to Atlantic.

properties.name: Mekong (Vientiane to mouth)
properties.notes: Cambodia and Vietnam Delta segments are most freight-active.

properties.name: Ganga National Waterway 1
properties.notes: Allahabad-Haldia; under Jal Marg Vikas Project deepening.

properties.name: Brahmaputra NW-2 + Bangladesh segment
properties.notes: Dibrugarh to Bay of Bengal via Bangladesh.

properties.name: Mahanadi
properties.notes: Sambalpur to Paradip; mostly potential, limited active bulk.

properties.name: Nile (Aswan to Mediterranean)
properties.notes: Cement, fertiliser; modest bulk.

properties.name: Congo (Kinshasa to Kisangani)
properties.notes: Long but informal; low volumes; encoded for completeness.
